At the relevant time the age of the victim was 16 years and 4 months and the applicant was 23 years of age.
The statement of the victim was recorded on April 29, 2022.
The victim has stated that there was a love affair between the applicant and the victim.
The applicant asked the victim to get all her gold ornaments which her father had prepared for her and the cash amount of Rs.70,000/-.
Accordingly, she left her home and started residing with the applicant.
Thereafter, it is stated that the applicant did not treat the victim well.
The victim resided with the applicant from December 27, 2021 to April 23, 2022.

It is alleged that the victim is pregnant.
The DNA report, however, is inconclusive.
6. The applicant's mother who also arraigned as an accused is absconding.
It is alleged that she sold all the gold ornaments which the victim has got along with her when she left her parental home.
7. The applicant is in custody since April 29, 2022 for a period of eight months.
Considering the nature of accusations, the applicant will face the consequences if on conclusion of the trial he is convicted.
However, in the present facts, as the investigation is complete, charge-sheet has been filed and the trial is not likely to conclude any time soon, the applicant can be enlarged on bail.
Hence the following order.
ORDER (a) The application is allowed.

(b) The applicant-Amit Popat Ugrija @ Amit Kharwa in connection with FIR No.256/2022 with Dadar Police Station, shall be released on bail on his furnishing Diksha Rane 19. BA 2923-22.doc P.R. Bond of Rs.25,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount.

(c) The applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer of the concerned police station once in a month on every first Monday of the month between 11.00 a.m. and 1.00 p.m.
